brief: TOP PICK: Hallmark — Design moat against AI slop. Ship UI taste tools NOW before commoditization.
Skills automation — Engineer workflow tooling. High signal from POC community.
AI Agent infra — Books + ADE tools (Orca) = land grab. Build the IDE for agents.
Graphify — Codebase as knowledge graph = memory layer for AI coding. Novel angle.
Timing: Design quality differentiation is NOW. AI slop fatigue is peaking.

items.name: Nutlope/hallmark
items.one_liner: Design skill preventing AI slop in generated UIs
items.pain_point: AI coding assistants generate generic, ugly UIs; indie devs and solo builders lack design skills to fix them and would pay for instant polish
app_ideas: Anti-slop component library with one-click install into Cursor/Raycast
UI quality scorer API that grades AI-generated code on design metrics
Design token export tool that speaks 'anti-slop' to any AI coding assistant
items.monetization: Freemium with premium design system access + B2B API wrapper for teams
items.why_now: AI coding assistants just went mainstream and everyone is realizing their UIs look like garbage
